sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 11)

purpose.zh: 练手臂撑住时身体还能摆，像真实支撑那样
purpose.en: Trains straight-arm support while your body swings, like the real move.

text.zh: 手臂一直锁直，以肩为轴整个人前后摆
text.en: Arms locked straight, swing your whole body from your shoulders

text.zh: 肩往下压，离耳朵远，肩膀一直停在手的正上方。
text.en: Press your shoulders down away from your ears, and keep them right over your hands.

text.zh: 腿并拢，从肩到脚一根棍，往前别折腰，往后别塌腰。
text.en: Legs together, one stiff line from shoulders to feet: don't bend at the hips in front or sag your back behind.

text.zh: 先小幅摆，前后一样高，都别高过杠面。
text.en: Start small, same height in front and behind, never above the bars.

commonErrors.zh: 往前折腰甩腿，往后塌腰
commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips to fling your legs forward, or sagging your back behind.
Swinging so big you lose control.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前侧疼就把幅度改小
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulders hurts, swing smaller.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (4 s per swing: 2 s forward, 2 s back; one forward + back = 1 rep)

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 9 后侧支撑 / 13 前侧支撑
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 3 组 × 10–20 次（一来一回 1 次）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 4 s (2 s forward, 2 s back), same amplitude every swing in the loop.

reminders.zh: 手臂锁直，肩在手正上方
reminders.en: Arms locked, shoulders right over hands
One stiff line, no bending at hips
